nodes.name: Every evening
nodes.notes: Runs once a day at 6 pm Brisbane time. Change the hour here if you want a different time.

nodes.name: Work out reminder
nodes.notes: Settings (days before, test mode, app link) are at the top of the code.

nodes.name: Send phone push (ntfy)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ topic: 'ddg-grocery-CHANGE-ME', title: $('Work out reminder').first().json.title, message: $('Work out reminder').first().json.message, tags: ['shopping_cart'], click: $('Work out reminder').first().json.appUrl, priority: 3 }) }}

nodes.notes: Change 'ddg-grocery-CHANGE-ME' to your own long random topic name. On a self-hosted ntfy, change the URL above too.

parameters.subject: =Grocery shop coming up
parameters.message:
